stop_condition: Postgres connection unavailable or connection test fails
required_action: Stop before execution and record blocked audit packet

stop_condition: Selected row writes output outside runs/user/<run_id>/
detection_method: Output-root guard plus post-run path inspection
required_action: Stop and discard local run output before committing

notes: Case packages are read-only for batch smoke.
User-run output must not update curated reports or results.
The future batch must not alter denominator values or membership.
The future batch must not update paper results.

detection_method: Diff scan and run-output manifest review
required_action: Stop and reject the run as out of scope
notes: Local diagnostics are not retained paper evidence.

detection_method: Command review and output scan for official metric artifacts
required_action: Stop and reject the run as out of scope
notes: Do not compute Generation Rate Execution Coverage Rate Result Consistency Rate speedup or paper metrics.

required_action: Stop and reject the run as out of scope

stop_condition: Global leaderboard output or ranking created
detection_method: Report/output scan for leaderboard ranking or method winner claims
required_action: Stop and reject the run as out of scope
notes: No global leaderboard boundary must be preserved.

stop_condition: Source candidate or checker artifact missing for selected row
required_action: Stop the batch and record failed row details
notes: Do not proceed to broader execution when required local artifacts are missing.

stop_condition: DB credential leakage detected in logs audit files or reports
detection_method: Manual redaction review and grep for DSN/password tokens
required_action: Stop and redact before any commit
notes: Do not store DB passwords or full DSNs.

stop_condition: Repeated schema setup failure across selected rows
required_action: Stop batch expansion and diagnose environment/schema setup
notes: Batch smoke should not mask systemic setup failures.

stop_condition: Checker config normalization config or compare config missing for selected row
detection_method: Static preflight and checker status review
required_action: Stop before execution for that selection
notes: Selected first-batch rows must have all checker assets.
